name: The order is placed
qualifier: stub: the web way sends a fixed test card (WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs:100-103)
right_outcome: proposed: an ordering.orders row in Submitted with one orderItems row per basket line at the catalogue price, the delivery address, and BuyerId and PaymentMethodId set

name: The customer's basket is emptied
right_outcome: proposed: the buyer's basket is gone once the order exists

name: The order is released for stock checking when the grace period ends
right_outcome: proposed: AwaitingValidation within 1.5 minutes of "OrderDate", with its OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidation outbox row at State 2 (Published)

name: Stock is confirmed for every item of the order
qualifier: partial: stock is checked, not reserved, so two orders can both be confirmed for the last unit (Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToPaidIntegrationEventHandler.cs:12)
right_outcome: proposed: StockConfirmed only when every ordered product is in the catalogue with AvailableStock of at least its units; Description 'All the items were confirmed with available stock.'

name: The order is cancelled because an item is out of stock
right_outcome: proposed: Cancelled, with Description naming the products without stock

name: Payment is taken for the order
qualifier: stub: the setting PaymentOptions:PaymentSucceeded stands in for a payment gateway (PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:15-28)
right_outcome: proposed: Paid, with the order total taken once from the buyer's payment method

name: The order is cancelled because payment failed
qualifier: stub: payment fails only when the setting PaymentOptions:PaymentSucceeded is false (PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:21-28)
right_outcome: proposed: Cancelled, with no payment taken

name: The order is cancelled at the customer's request
qualifier: partial: only the mobile app offers it, and it ships with mock services on (ClientApp/Services/Settings/SettingsService.cs:25); a payment already in flight is not stopped (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:121)
right_outcome: proposed: Cancelled before any payment is taken

name: Stock is reduced by the order's units
right_outcome: proposed: each item's AvailableStock reduced by its units

name: Webhook subscribers are told the order is paid
right_outcome: proposed: one post to each OrderPaid subscription, carrying the order's id and items

name: The order is shipped
qualifier: partial: nothing in the application calls the ship endpoint; a person must call it with their own client
right_outcome: proposed: Shipped once the goods have left

name: Webhook subscribers are told the order is shipped
right_outcome: proposed: one post to each OrderShipped subscription

name: The order is delivered to the customer
right_outcome: proposed: the customer has the goods
source: reference model: SCOR 12.0's Deliver process covers providing finished goods to meet demand, typically including transportation and distribution management (secondary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supply_chain_operations_reference); no lifecycle row carries it, and the code records nothing after Shipped (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/OrderStatus.cs:12)
